title: AES77 Streaming Music
summary: A monitoring Profile for track-normalized internet music distribution.
descriptionMarkdown: AES77 recommends −16 LUFS Distribution Loudness for track-normalized music and a Maximum True Peak no higher than −1 dBTP at the input of a lossy encoder. This Profile warns above the nominal target rather than treating the permitted upper tolerance as an operating goal. AES77 separately recommends −14 LUFS for the loudest track when album-loudest-track normalization is used; that workflow depends on relationships across an album and is intentionally not represented by this single-item Profile. AES77 does not prescribe Loudness Range, so no LRA rule is added.

references.title: AES77-2023 Loudness Guidelines for Internet Audio Streaming and On-Demand Distribution
references.relevanceMarkdown: Defines the track-normalized music target, album alternative, tolerance and True Peak recommendation represented by this Profile.

references.title: Loudness Normalization
references.relevanceMarkdown: Explains track and album normalization and the −16 LUFS track-normalized music recommendation.

releases.notesMarkdown: Initial monitoring release for track-normalized AES77 music distribution.
